data.name: The Ghost Of Solaris
data.detailed_description:
A Legend Returned. A City Transformed. A Debt That Must Be Paid.

Solaris Bay: a sprawling, sun-bleached metropolis once built on heritage and grit, now "renewed" into a clinical corporate utopia. Behind the gleaming glass of the Silver District lies a city divided by debt, fueled by a dangerous new addiction, and controlled by a tyrant who views the poor as liabilities.

Five years ago, Zain Malik was the most feared enforcer in the streets. Betrayed by his brothers and left to rot, he returns to a world he no longer recognizes. As the legendary "Ghost," he must plunge into a high-stakes criminal underworld to dismantle the empire that stole his life.

SOLARIS BAY: A CITY OF TWO WORLDS

Explore a metropolis of extreme contrasts. Navigate the dense, vertical markets of the Old Colony, where every alleyway hides a secret and a survivalist's price. Then, breach the clinical luxury of the Silver District, a sanctuary for the elite guarded by private armies and state-of-the-art surveillance.

STRATEGIC REVOLUTION

Forget mindless violence. In Solaris Bay, survival is a game of calculated risks. Execute a relentless 20-mission campaign where your choices dictate the fate of the city.

  • Infiltrate & Clear Areas: Plan and execute daring raids on high-security corporate spots and hidden black markets to to loosen Sterling's influence on city.

  • Act Fast Mechanics: Sabotage power grids, do stealth attacks, and blind the enemy’s drone nets to stay one step ahead.

  • High-Stakes Attack First Strategy: Attack before you are attacked. Find covers, do melee attacks, takeout enemies silently to reduce enemy's strength in occupied areas.

THE CREW (SQUAD)

You aren't fighting this war alone. You have your squad in shadows that helps you navigate through unknown paths of the Sterling empire.

  • Abbas

  • Farah

  • Elena

THE POWER OF CHOICE

You have the power over either keep going or give up and let Sterling's empire wipe out innocents.

The concrete is thirsty and at edge of extinction of goodness. How much are you willing to pay to settle the debt?

GAME MODES

There are two game modes to play without any locks, need of unlocking next mission, and wait.

1. CAMPAIGN MODE

This mode includes 20 missions waiting for you to play at your own pace, and order.

2. OPEN WORLD MODE

Navigate Solaris Bay. Visit neon drenched slums, drive multiple variety of cars, and visit train stations.

data.short_description: When a legendary enforcer returns to a city transformed into a corporate prison, he must coordinate a high-stakes revolution to save his family and settle a debt written in blood. Experience a gritty story of betrayal and vengeance across the neon-drenched slums and silver towers of Solaris Bay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: : Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350 (Equivalent to entry-level Xeon E5 series)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 (8GB recommended) / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 27 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Broadband Internet Connection is required to play multiplayer. SSD is required for Nanite's high-speed geometry streaming. Multiplayer mode supports DirectX11 and Vulkan as well Tho Base Single Player might only support DirectX12. Multiplayer works even on an HDD.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (12GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 27 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Broadband Internet Connection is required to play multiplayer NVMe SSD strongly recommended for optimal Nanite geometry streaming and minimal load times. Multiplayer mode supports DirectX11 and Vulkan as well Tho Base Single Player might only support DirectX12. Multiplayer works even on an HDD.
